plugin.name: RetroArch
plugin.description: RetroArch in the Mire store: installed from the libretro website, with a choice of consoles (NES, Super Nintendo, Game Boy, Nintendo 64, Mega Drive…) and a BIOS reminder. Mire never provides any BIOS.

retroarch.name: RetroArch
retroarch.description: One program for 8-bit and 16-bit consoles, the Game Boy family and the Nintendo 64. Choose the consoles to add.
retroarch.bios: Depending on the console: gba_bios.bin (Game Boy Advance), bios_CD_E.bin, bios_CD_U.bin, bios_CD_J.bin (Mega-CD), syscard3.pce (PC Engine CD)…
